.review-overlay {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(13, 43, 51, 0.55);
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 18px 12px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.review-overlay.open {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
}

.review-modal {
  background: #ffffff;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 40px auto;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(183, 154, 87, 0.45);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(13, 43, 51, 0.28);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.review-modal-header {
  background: #2f7f96;
  color: #ffffff;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.review-modal-body {
  padding: 16px 18px 6px;
}

.review-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(183, 154, 87, 0.4);
  font-size: 15px;
}

.review-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.review-row .review-label {
  color: #7c6a3a;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.review-row .review-value {
  color: #1d2f35;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: left;
}

.review-row.review-total .review-label,
.review-row.review-total .review-value {
  color: #137333;
  font-size: 17px;
}

.review-modal-error {
  display: none;
  background: #fdecea;
  color: #b00020;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  margin: 10px 18px 0;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.review-modal-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 14px 18px 18px;
}

.review-modal-actions button {
  margin-top: 0;
  padding: 13px;
  font-size: 16px;
}

#reviewConfirmBtn {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d7a46, #166437) !important;
}

#reviewConfirmBtn:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #166437, #115230) !important;
}

#reviewConfirmBtn:disabled {
  background: #888 !important;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

#reviewBackBtn {
  background: #ffffff !important;
  color: #2f7f96 !important;
  border: 2px solid #2f7f96 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

#reviewBackBtn:hover {
  background: #eef6f8 !important;
}

#reviewRetryBtn {
  display: none;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #b07c1f, #96690f) !important;
}

#reviewWhatsappBtn{display:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25d366,#128c4a)!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(18,140,74,.24)}
#reviewDoneBtn{display:none;background:#fff!important;color:#2f7f96!important;border:2px solid #2f7f96!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.review-modal.saved-result .review-modal-header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1d7a46,#2f7f96)}


 
.start-exam-btn {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d7a46, #166437) !important;
}

.start-exam-btn:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #166437, #115230) !important;
}

.grade-result-box {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: bold;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #dce3eb;
}

.grade-result-box .grade-title {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  color: #555;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.grade-result-box .grade-value {
  font-size: 19px;
  color: #2f7f96;
}

.grade-result-box.pass {
  background: #e6f4ea;
  border-color: #34a853;
}

.grade-result-box.pass .grade-value {
  color: #137333;
}

.grade-result-box.fail {
  background: #fdecea;
  border-color: #c00000;
}

.grade-result-box.fail .grade-value {
  color: #b00020;
}

.review-value.pass-status {
  color: #137333;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.review-value.fail-status {
  color: #c00000;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.search-note {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 5px;
  color: #666;
  font-size: 12px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .review-modal {
    margin: 12px auto;
  }

  .review-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .review-row .review-value {
    text-align: right;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }

  .review-modal-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}



 
.auth-screen {

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;

}

  min-height: 22px;

  display: flex;

  align-items: center;

  margin-bottom: 14px;

  color: #475467;

.auth-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;

.auth-toolbar button {
  width: auto;

  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.secondary-action {
  background: #eef2f6 !important;
  color: #344054 !important;
}

.danger-action {
  background: #fff1f0 !important;
  color: #b42318 !important;
}

  <script>
  let students = [];
  let supervisorToken = '';
  let supervisorSession = null;
  let requestedStudentId = '';

  

  let isSaving = false;          
  let pendingData = null;        
  let pendingOpId = '';          
  let lastSavedSummary = null;

  const EMBEDDED_NAVIGATION_TICKET = "";
    const SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY = 'studentExamAuthToken';
  const SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY = 'studentExamAuthSession';

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    initializeSupervisorAuth();
  });

  function initializeSupervisorAuth() {
    const savedToken = sessionStorage.getItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY) || '';

    if (savedToken) {
      verifySupervisorToken(savedToken);
      return;
    }

    initializeFromNavigationTicket();
  }

  function verifySupervisorToken(token) {
    setAuthMessage('جاري التحقق من الجلسة...', false);

    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
        if (response && response.ok && response.authenticated) {
          acceptSupervisorSession(token, response);
          return;
        }

        clearSupervisorSession();
        initializeFromNavigationTicket(response && response.message
          ? response.message
          : 'انتهت الجلسة. افتح الصفحة من بوابة النظام.');
      })
      .withFailureHandler(function () {
        clearSupervisorSession();
        initializeFromNavigationTicket(
          'تعذر التحقق من الجلسة. افتح الصفحة من بوابة النظام.'
        );
      })
      .securityVerifySupervisorSession(token);
  }

  function initializeFromNavigationTicket(fallbackMessage) {
    const embeddedTicket = String(EMBEDDED_NAVIGATION_TICKET || '').trim();
    if (embeddedTicket) {
      consumeNavigationTicket(embeddedTicket, fallbackMessage);
      return;
    }

    google.script.url.getLocation(function (location) {
      const ticket =
        location && location.parameter ? String(location.parameter.ticket || '') : '';

      if (!ticket) {
        showAuthScreen(fallbackMessage || 'يلزم تسجيل الدخول من بوابة النظام.');
        return;
      }

      consumeNavigationTicket(ticket, fallbackMessage);
    });
  }

  function consumeNavigationTicket(ticket, fallbackMessage) {
    setAuthMessage('جاري فتح صفحة الاختبار...', false);
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
        if (
          response &&
          response.ok &&
          response.authenticated &&
          response.token
        ) {
          acceptSupervisorSession(response.token, response);
          return;
        }

        showAuthScreen(response && response.message
          ? response.message
          : (fallbackMessage || 'تعذر فتح الصفحة. ارجع إلى بوابة النظام.'));
      })
      .withFailureHandler(function () {
        showAuthScreen('تعذر فتح الصفحة. ارجع إلى بوابة النظام وحاول مرة أخرى.');
      })
      .authPortalConsumeNavigationTicket(ticket, 'direct');
  }

  function acceptSupervisorSession(token, response) {
    supervisorToken = token;
    supervisorSession = response;
    sessionStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, token);
    sessionStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify({
      displayName: response.displayName || response.name || response.identifier || '',
      role: response.role || ''
    }));
    showExamApp();
    readRequestedStudentThenLoad();
  }

  function readRequestedStudentThenLoad() {
    google.script.url.getLocation(function (location) {
      requestedStudentId = location && location.parameter
        ? String(location.parameter.requestId || '').trim()
        : '';
      loadStudents();
    });
  }

  function supervisorLogout() {
    const token = supervisorToken;
    clearSupervisorSession();
    showAuthScreen('تم تسجيل الخروج.');

    if (token) {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(goToLoggedOutPortal)
        .withFailureHandler(goToLoggedOutPortal)
        .authStaffPortalLogout(token);
      return;
    }

    goToLoggedOutPortal();
  }

  function goToLoggedOutPortal() {
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(function (url) { window.top.location.replace(url + '?page=admin&logout=1'); })
      .withFailureHandler(function () { window.top.location.href = '?page=admin&logout=1'; })
      .getSystemWebAppUrl();
  }

  function clearSupervisorSession() {
    supervisorToken = '';
    supervisorSession = null;
    students = [];
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY);
    try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY); } catch (ignore) {}
    try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY); } catch (ignore) {}
    try { sessionStorage.removeItem('TDK_DATA_ENTRY_AUTH'); } catch (ignore) {}
  }

  function showAuthScreen(message) {
    document.getElementById('authScreen').classList.remove('hidden');
    document.getElementById('appContainer').classList.add('hidden');
    setAuthMessage(message || '', Boolean(message));

  function normalizeArabicText(text) {
    return String(text || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[أإآٱ]/g, 'ا')
      .replace(/ى/g, 'ي')
      .replace(/ة/g, 'ه')
      .replace(/ؤ/g, 'و')
      .replace(/ئ/g, 'ي')
      .replace(/[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  }

  function normalizeDigitsClient(text) {
    return String(text || '')
      .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, function (digit) {
        return String('٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(digit));
      })
      .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function (digit) {
        return String('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(digit));
      })
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  }

  function isDigitsOnlySearch(text) {
    const raw = String(text || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return false;
    const withoutSpaces = raw.replace(/\s+/g, '');
    return /^[0-9٠-٩۰-۹]+$/.test(withoutSpaces);
  }

    const element = document.getElementById('reviewModalError');
    element.textContent = '';

  function toFriendlyErrorMessage(rawMessage) {
    const message = String(rawMessage || '');
    
    if (/[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(message) && message.length <= 120) {
      return message;
    }
    return 'تعذر حفظ النتيجة. تأكد من الاتصال ثم حاول مرة أخرى.';

  function hideMessages() {

  function showHijriDate() {
    const value =
      document.getElementById('examDate').value;

    const hijriInput =
      document.getElementById('hijriDate');

    if (!value) {
      hijriInput.value = '';
      return;
    }

    const date = new Date(value + 'T12:00:00');

    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
      'ar-SA-u-ca-islamic-umalqura',
      {
        weekday: 'long',
        day: 'numeric',
        month: 'long',
        year: 'numeric'
      }
    );

    hijriInput.value = formatter.format(date);
  }

  function validateGrade(input, maximum) {
    if (input.value === '') {
      calculateTotal();
      return;
    }

    let value = Number(input.value);

    if (isNaN(value) || value < 0) {
      value = 0;
    }

    if (value > maximum) {
      value = maximum;
    }

    input.value = value;
    calculateTotal();
  }

  function isValidScore(value, maximum) {
    if (value === '') return false;

    const number = Number(value);

    return (
      !isNaN(number) &&
      number >= 0 &&
      number <= maximum
    );
  }

  function getScore(id) {
    const value = document.getElementById(id).value;
    return value === '' ? 0 : Number(value);
  }

  function calculateTotal() {
    const total =
      getScore('q1') +
      getScore('q2') +
      getScore('q3') +
      getScore('q4') +
      getScore('tajweed') +
      getScore('performance');

    document.getElementById('degree').value = total;
    updateGradeDisplay();
  }

   
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    ['q1','q2','q3','q4','tajweed','performance'].forEach(function (id) {
      var input = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!input || input.parentElement.classList.contains('score-control')) return;
      var maximum = Number(input.max || 20);
      var control = document.createElement('div');
      control.className = 'score-control';
      var minus = document.createElement('button');
      minus.type = 'button'; minus.className = 'score-adjust'; minus.textContent = '−'; minus.setAttribute('aria-label','نقص الدرجة');
      var plus = document.createElement('button');
      plus.type = 'button'; plus.className = 'score-adjust'; plus.textContent = '+'; plus.setAttribute('aria-label','زيادة الدرجة');

      minus.addEventListener('click',function(){change(-0.5)}); plus.addEventListener('click',function(){change(0.5)});
    });
  });
